question: What attributes belonging to the great lord are to be ritually represented?
premises: An object is described as endowed with birth and sheath.
This endowed object belongs to the great lord.
The description identifies what is to be represented.
inference: The ritual representation concerns that aspect of the great lord which is endowed with birth and sheath.
uncertainties: The exact referent of jāti-kośa-yutam in this ritual context is not fully explicit.
plain_english: And that which is endowed with birth and sheath belongs to the great lord.
